Install zen-browser on Omarchy

Official package for Zen, a privacy-focused, feature packed Firefox-based web browser

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2026-09-26.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add zen-browser-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.24.1b-1:
    pacman -Qi zen-browser-bin

Open and use zen-browser

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql zen-browser-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install zen-browser on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add zen-browser-bin. The download is 151.3 MB and it takes 427.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is zen-browser free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MPL-2.0.

How do I uninstall zen-browser?

Run omarchy pkg drop zen-browser-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does zen-browser depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: gtk3, libxt, mime-types, dbus-glib, nss, ttf-font, systemd, ffmpeg. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is zen-browser in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as zen-browser-bin (version 1.24.1b-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. zen-browser makes it. Project site: https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop.
